audit_scope: precisely separate checked primary theorem statements from bibliographic/abstract-only entries; NOT full proof audit

entries.title: Model-Generic Incrementally Verifiable Computation from Updatable BARGs
entries.barrier: Incremental verification and BARG setup require explicit circuit/encoding, prover time, trusted anchor, historical PIN.
entries.missing_proof: No same-task circuit and setup accounting

entries.title: The cell probe complexity of dynamic data structures
entries.barrier: GF(2) partial-sums includes prefix parity, but SET->FLIP encoding, free preprocessing, word size and F1 trusted authority must be tracked.
entries.missing_proof: No F1-to-cell-probe resource-preserving reduction

entries.title: Logarithmic Lower Bounds in the Cell-Probe Model
entries.barrier: Theorem 2.1 uses delta=Omega(b); Theorem 2.2 uses integer-valued partial sums and small-delta accounting; no b-bit-update transfer for binary SET.
entries.missing_proof: No GF2 small-alphabet, trusted-space and page-I/O transfer

entries.title: An $\Omega((\log n / \log\log n)^2)$ Cell-Probe Lower Bound for Dynamic Boolean Data Structures
entries.barrier: Revised Theorem 1.1 is Multiphase with arbitrary GF2 inner product, m=n^(1+Omega(1)) and word-size terms; contiguous 1D range query is not this problem.
entries.missing_proof: No low-overhead Multiphase-to-contiguous-range reduction

entries.title: Checking the Correctness of Memories
entries.barrier: Memory checker protects arbitrary read/write interfaces with trusted space and remote probes; model equivalence for paid roots is missing.
entries.missing_proof: Original proof and paid-anchor translation

entries.title: Memory Checking Requires Logarithmic Overhead
entries.barrier: Computational memory-checker q-versus-s bound, with independent monotone root and durable pin control absent as free primitives.
entries.missing_proof: Theorem-level quantifiers and F1 adversarial reduction

entries.title: The Complexity of Memory Checking with Covert Security
entries.barrier: Covert security and detection failure do not equal F1 soundness/ABORT guarantees.
entries.missing_proof: Convert covert detection to F1 computational soundness

entries.title: Vector Commitments with Efficient Updates
entries.barrier: AFT 2023 Definition 4 and Theorem 5 require proof-binding dynamic VC, proof-update time g2(k) and broadcast update information g1(k); neither denotes GC page writes.
entries.missing_proof: Prove proof-binding + circuit mapping and account k, epsilon, update diff

entries.title: Merkle Mountain Ranges are Optimal: On Witness Update Frequency for Cryptographic Accumulators
entries.barrier: Witness-update frequency for append-only accumulators is not the number of immutable pages retained or reclaimed.
entries.missing_proof: Historical PIN and physical GC transfer

entries.title: Lower Bounding Update Frequency in Short Accumulators and Vector Commitments
entries.barrier: Expected witness invalidation/frequency for short accumulators/VCs has different randomness and output than disk page moves.
entries.missing_proof: Expected-to-worst and witness-to-page mapping

entries.title: Secure Untrusted Data Repository (SUNDR)
entries.barrier: Fork consistency permits divergent views until communication; does not furnish independent global LATEST authority.
entries.missing_proof: No shared single-server anchor reduction

entries.title: Verifying the consistency of remote untrusted services with conflict-free operations
entries.barrier: COP conflict-free operations and fork linearizability are not global latest detection.
entries.missing_proof: No independent reader latest theorem

entries.title: SNARKs for stateful computations on authenticated data
entries.barrier: Stateful authenticated computation is a conditional proof-system comparator with paid setup and prover work.
entries.missing_proof: Circuit for range parity and epoch/freshness integration

entries.title: The Cell Probe Complexity of Dynamic Range Counting
entries.barrier: Weighted 2D orthogonal dynamic range counting with multi-bit answers differs from binary 1D range parity.
entries.missing_proof: No weighted/2D-to-binary/1D cost-preserving reduction

entries.title: Cell-probe lower bounds for dynamic problems via a new communication model
entries.barrier: Nondeterministic communication lower bounds for interval union etc require a stated reduction to SET/parity.
entries.missing_proof: A source-level reduction preserving operations and error

entries.title: Making data structures persistent
entries.barrier: DSST persistence has version access and node copying but not independently trusted epoch publication, PIN authority or full-page crash-safe GC.
entries.missing_proof: Pack/persistence/GC comparator under identical F1 costs

entries.title: Authenticated Data Structures for Dynamic Workloads
entries.barrier: Adaptive Huffman Merkle tree is proof-size/updates upper comparator under workloads; worst-case hard ranges and PIN durability still need pricing.
entries.missing_proof: Authenticated range proof, updates and migration costs

entries.title: Integrita: A BFT distributed storage system
entries.barrier: Distributed BFT storage q-detectable view assumptions do not match one server with separately trusted global monotone root.
entries.missing_proof: Trust topologies and communication model differ

entries.title: Cauchyproofs: Batch-Updatable Vector Commitment with Easy Aggregation and Application to Stateless Blockchains
entries.barrier: Cauchyproofs batch witness aggregation is not a physical historical GC lower bound.
entries.missing_proof: Compare same F1 circuit and preprocessing/prover/reader work

entries.title: Cell-Probe Lower Bounds via Semi-Random CSP Refutation: Simplified and the Odd-Locality Case
entries.barrier: GLY derives STATIC cell-probe / NC0 range-avoidance lower bounds from semi-random CSP refutation; not dynamic F1 pages.
entries.missing_proof: New dynamic reduction and amortized/PIN preservation required
